name: San Diego Miramar College Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at Miramar College while in high school and earn credit toward a degree or transfer. Some high schools also offer CCAP college classes on their own campus during the school day.
who_can_apply: Eligible high school students. You must clear class prerequisites and show proof. The class must count toward a college degree. Exercise Science classes are not allowed.
pay_detail: Enrollment fees are waived under 12 units. CCAP tuition and textbooks are free. Ask Admissions about other fees and books.
deadline_text: Send a new form each term. The district page lists no date as of Nov 2, 2026. Ask Miramar Admissions about the term you want.
how_to_apply: Apply online to get a student ID. Send the supplemental form each term with the class numbers you want. Staff then enroll you. If a class is full, they contact you. For CCAP, ask your high school counselor first.
notes: These steps come from the district page, since Miramar sends high school students there. Keep a 2.0 GPA each semester. Grades stay on your college record. Miramar Admissions: 619-388-7844 or miraadm@sdccd.edu.
